rulesets.floor: Hollow Knight inspired hand-drawn 2D SEAMLESS TILEABLE ground texture: painterly dirt and stone, muted desaturated dark palette, soft shading, subtle cracks and grit, NO visible grid, NO characters, NO UI, NO text. Must tile cleanly on all four edges. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D.
rulesets.bg: Hollow Knight inspired hand-drawn 2D background: clean dark linework, muted desaturated deep blues and greys, soft painterly shading, melancholic fog. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D. A WIDE 16:9 SCENE used under UI — left half and center calm and dark, detail toward upper right and edges. No characters, no creatures, no text, no UI, no frames.
